summary: The filing reports AEP Texas Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of American Electric Power, entering into a material definitive agreement with the DOE and FFB for a $3.26 billion loan facility under the DOE Loan Program. The multi-draw term loan, maturing April 15, 2056, will finance roughly 100 transmission projects spanning 2,800 miles. Interest is semiannual at the U.S. Treasury rate plus 0.375%. Upfront fees of $8.43 million were paid. This is a routine project financing, not a special situation transaction.
